## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The parser removes `--wait` outright, so existing invocations fail at parse time, while the ADR added in this pull request commits to keeping it as a deprecated alias for one release. This must be fixed before merge.

## Changes
The pull request renames the `--wait` CLI option to `--timeout` in `app/cli.py` and updates `tests/test_cli.py` to use the new name. It also adds `docs/adr/007-timeout.md` describing the transition and a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.

## Critical
- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Keep `--wait` as a deprecated alias for `--timeout` — `parse_args(["--wait", "12"])` now exits with status 2 as an unrecognized argument, because this line replaces `--wait` instead of adding `--timeout` beside it. `docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5` states "Accept `--wait` as an alias for one release and emit a deprecation warning when it is used." — Existing scripts that pass `--wait` fail at argument parsing after upgrade, with no deprecation release. — Fix: Register `--wait` with `dest="timeout"` and a deprecation warning when it is used, and extend `test_explicit_options` in `tests/test_cli.py` to cover it.
